name: Gemeente Amsterdam
description: Gemeente Amsterdam's own design tokens, from @amsterdam/design-system-tokens: blue interaction on white, red reserved for feedback.
_comment_source: Derived from @amsterdam/design-system-tokens 4.4.0 (https://registry.npmjs.org/@amsterdam/design-system-tokens/-/design-system-tokens-4.4.0.tgz), Ruben's decision of 19 Nov 2026.
A partial brand file: the package's --ams-color-* palette is section A and its other --ams-* tokens section B.
The ramp maps a published colour onto the role layer's step of the same role (interactive, text, separator,
feedback), each naming the token it is read from; every other step is left to Nextcloud. The semantic layer
takes only the values the package assigns to that role.
